description: This file defines data structures, macros, and function prototypes for filtering, sorting, and formatting references (refs) in a version control system, likely Git. It includes definitions for ref filtering options, ref sorting, ref formatting, and related operations.

methods.name: ref_kind_from_refname
methods.description: Determines the reference kind from a reference name string.

methods.name: filter_refs
methods.description: Filters a set of references based on provided filter criteria and type.

methods.name: filter_and_format_refs
methods.description: Filters references, sorts, formats, and prints them according to specified options.

methods.name: ref_array_clear
methods.description: Clears all memory allocated to a ref_array.

methods.name: verify_ref_format
methods.description: Verifies and finalizes the ref_format structure.

methods.name: ref_array_sort
methods.description: Sorts a ref_array based on specified sorting criteria.

methods.name: ref_sorting_set_sort_flags_all
methods.description: Sets sort flags for all elements in a ref_sorting list.

methods.name: format_ref_array_item
methods.description: Formats a ref_array_item into a string buffer according to ref_format.

methods.name: ref_sorting_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a ref_sorting object.

methods.name: ref_sorting_options
methods.description: Converts a list of sort options into a ref_sorting structure.

methods.name: get_head_description
methods.description: Returns a description of the current HEAD.

methods.name: setup_ref_filter_porcelain_msg
methods.description: Initializes translated strings for porcelain output.

methods.name: print_formatted_ref_array
methods.description: Prints a list of refs formatted according to ref_format.

methods.name: pretty_print_ref
methods.description: Prints a single reference in a formatted manner.

methods.name: ref_array_push
methods.description: Adds a new reference to a ref_array.

methods.name: ref_filter_clear
methods.description: Clears resources in a ref_filter structure.
